授業概要
超高感度計測技術、信号処理法、極限環境下における計測技法、及び応用計測システムなどの先端計測に関する研究での博士論文作成のための研究指導を行う。
Guidance is provided for the preparation of doctoral papers in research on advanced measurement such as ultra-sensitive measurement technology, signal processing method, measurement technique in extreme environment, and applied measurement system.

授業の進め方
実験計画の立案、実験結果に関する討議などを通じて、未知な領域を切り拓く独創力や実行力、社会的価値に結びつける企画力を、また国内外の学会での研究発表ならびに学術論文の執筆を通じて説得力、国際力の涵養を行う。
Through the formulation of experimental plans and discussions on experimental results, etc., the students will cultivate their creativity and ability to implement new initiatives that open up unknown fields, as well as their planning ability to link them to social value. They will also cultivate persuasiveness and international competence through research presentations at academic conferences in Japan and abroad and by writing academic papers.
